conservation.technical_description:
Surface:  The thicker areas of blue pigment at the upper right have patches of craquelure throughout; these areas of craquelure appear to be stable. Along the outer edge of the tree branches at center right are very fine areas of craquelure and a minor accretion in the white area between the different shades of blue. At the lower right corner, in the light blue is a very faint stain.  There are minor sections of craquelure at the lower left and center of the image, with both areas at the base of the blue tree trunks. Throughout the thicker areas of the maroon pigment at the left are patches of very fine craquelure, these sections appear to be stable.  At the lower left near the side edge of the larger blue tree is a section of very fine craquelure. There is a pair of minor accretions in the light blue near the edge of the image at the upper left. 
 
Support: The support has inherent planar distortions throughout. There are a few minor wrinkles at the lower left of the support near the bottom leaves of the large blue tree and at lower center in the leaves of the maroon tree. 
 
Mat:  The mat has a moderate scratch at the lower left just adjacent to the left corner of the image. 
 
Frame:  There is surface grime throughout the face of the frame. Along the top of the frame are scattered white accretions at the left and right, minor chips at center on the interior, at the left and at the left corner, a pair of minor scuff marks at center, and a series of short vertical scratches along the interior left side. The upper right corner of the frame has a series of scratches and a moderate chip the along inside edge. The right side of the frame has a series of minor chips along the upper half, a series of scratches, accretions and a moderate chip along the lower half and a series of scratches, minor chips, and heavy black scuff marks at the lower corner.  The bottom edge of the frame has fine scratches throughout the face and a section of scuffs and minor chips at the left corner. The lower half of the left panel of the frame has three minor chips and a section of minor scuffs. Along the upper half of the left panel near the top are black scuff marks, minor chips and heavy surface grime.  There are fine scratches throughout the Plexiglas surface.

description: Watercolor on rice paper. A dark red house stands on the left side of the composition, behind two low green trees. On the right side, two dark blue trees span the length of the composition. A dark blue sky and pale moon are visible in the distance. All elements of the composition are made up of curling, twisting brushstrokes that leave small bits of the paper exposed.
